title: Corpus
body: I scraped public Dive Club episodes: 317 of them, from the show's own feeds.
Host speech is the only thing the models train on; guests are labeled and left out.

title: Transcribe + diarize
body: Whisper wrote every word with timestamps, and speaker embeddings sorted out who said what.
I skipped gated models, so the whole pipeline runs on one RTX 3060.

title: Persona LLMs
body: One LoRA per host on Qwen3.5-4B-Base, trained on their own speech only.
Held-out perplexity fell for both: Ridd 16.1 to 13.0, Tommy 18.6 to 17.1.

title: System One
body: Kev-4B's decision adapter and pointer head sit on top of each persona backbone.
The idea: voice from the persona, a fast first judgment from the module.

title: What I learned
body: Voice transferred; judgment did not. A 4B model picks up how someone talks, not what they would decide.
The decision module survives the backbone swap: 0.805 Ridd, 0.811 Tommy, vs 0.811 for Kev on 656 questions.
